#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, flow, cost;
};

const int N = 14043;
const ll INF64 = (ll)1e18;

vector<Edge> e;
vector<int> g[N];

ll d[N];
int p[N], pe[N];
bool inq[N];

int s = N - 2;
int t = N - 1;
ll ans = 0;

int rem(int id) {
    return e[id].cap - e[id].flow;
}

void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
    g[u].push_back((int)e.size());
    e.push_back({v, cap, 0, cost});
    g[v].push_back((int)e.size());
    e.push_back({u, 0, 0, -cost});
}

void push_one() {
    fill(d, d + N, INF64);
    fill(p, p + N, -1);
    fill(pe, pe + N, -1);
    fill(inq, inq + N, false);

    queue<int> q;
    d[s] = 0;
    q.push(s);
    inq[s] = true;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inq[u] = false;

        for (int id : g[u]) {
            if (rem(id) <= 0) continue;
            int v = e[id].to;
            ll nd = d[u] + e[id].cost;
            if (nd < d[v]) {
                d[v] = nd;
                p[v] = u;
                pe[v] = id;
                if (!inq[v]) {
                    inq[v] = true;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int cur = t;
    while (cur != s) {
        int id = pe[cur];
        e[id].flow++;
        e[id ^ 1].flow--;
        cur = p[cur];
    }

    ans += d[t];
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        add_edge(s, x, 1, 0);
    }

    int tt = 101;
    for (int i = 0; i < tt; i++)
        add_edge(1 + i * n, t, k, i * c);

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        for (int step = 0; step < tt - 1; step++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                add_edge(x + step * n, y + step * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
                add_edge(y + step * n, x + step * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    for (int city = 0; city < n; city++)
        for (int step = 0; step < tt - 1; step++)
            add_edge(city + step * n, city + step * n + n, k, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
        push_one();

    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}

const int N = 14043;
const ll INF = (ll)1e18;

struct MinCostFlow {
    struct Edge {
        int to, cap, flow, cost;
    };

    int n;
    vector<vector<int>> g;
    vector<Edge> e;
    vector<ll> dist;
    vector<int> pv, pe, inq;
    ll total;

    MinCostFlow(int n) : n(n), g(n), dist(n), pv(n), pe(n), inq(n), total(0) {}

    int residual(int id) const {
        return e[id].cap - e[id].flow;
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        g[u].push_back((int)e.size());
        e.push_back({v, cap, 0, cost});
        g[v].push_back((int)e.size());
        e.push_back({u, 0, 0, -cost});
    }

    void augment(int s, int t) {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
        fill(pv.begin(), pv.end(), -1);
        fill(pe.begin(), pe.end(), -1);
        fill(inq.begin(), inq.end(), 0);

        queue<int> q;
        dist[s] = 0;
        q.push(s);
        inq[s] = 1;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            inq[u] = 0;

            for (int id : g[u]) {
                if (residual(id) <= 0) continue;
                int v = e[id].to;
                if (dist[v] > dist[u] + e[id].cost) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + e[id].cost;
                    pv[v] = u;
                    pe[v] = id;
                    if (!inq[v]) {
                        inq[v] = 1;
                        q.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int cur = t;
        while (cur != s) {
            int id = pe[cur];
            e[id].flow++;
            e[id ^ 1].flow--;
            cur = pv[cur];
        }

        total += dist[t];
    }

    ll minCost(int s, int t, int flow) {
        for (int i = 0; i < flow; i++) augment(s, t);
        return total;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    const int S = N - 2;
    const int T = N - 1;
    MinCostFlow mf(N);

    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        mf.addEdge(S, x, 1, 0);
    }

    int tt = 101;
    for (int i = 0; i < tt; i++)

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {

            }

    }

    for (int city = 0; city < n; city++)

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

struct Edge {
    int from, to, cap, flow, cost;
};

const int N = 14043;
const ll INF = (ll)4e18;

vector<Edge> edges;
vector<int> adj[N];

ll potential[N], dist[N];
int pv[N], pe[N];

int S = N - 2;
int T = N - 1;
ll answer = 0;

void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
    adj[u].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.push_back({u, v, cap, 0, cost});
    adj[v].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.push_back({v, u, 0, 0, -cost});
}

void dijkstra() {
    fill(dist, dist + N, INF);
    fill(pv, pv + N, -1);
    fill(pe, pe + N, -1);

    priority_queue<pair<ll, int>, vector<pair<ll, int>>, greater<pair<ll, int>>> pq;
    dist[S] = 0;
    pq.push({0, S});

    while (!pq.empty()) {
        auto cur = pq.top();
        pq.pop();

        ll d = cur.first;
        int u = cur.second;

        if (d != dist[u]) continue;

        for (int id : adj[u]) {
            if (edges[id].cap - edges[id].flow <= 0) continue;

            int v = edges[id].to;
            ll w = (ll)edges[id].cost + potential[u] - potential[v];

            if (dist[v] > d + w) {
                dist[v] = d + w;
                pv[v] = u;
                pe[v] = id;
                pq.push({dist[v], v});
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        if (dist[i] < INF / 2)
            potential[i] += dist[i];
}

void augment() {
    int cur = T;
    while (cur != S) {
        int id = pe[cur];
        edges[id].flow++;
        edges[id ^ 1].flow--;
        cur = pv[cur];
    }
    answer += potential[T];
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        addEdge(S, x, 1, 0);
    }

    int tt = 101;
    for (int i = 0; i < tt; i++)
        addEdge(1 + i * n, T, k, i * c);

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        for (int step = 0; step < tt - 1; step++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                addEdge(x + step * n, y + step * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
                addEdge(y + step * n, x + step * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    for (int city = 0; city < n; city++)
        for (int step = 0; step < tt - 1; step++)
            addEdge(city + step * n, city + step * n + n, k, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        dijkstra();
        augment();
    }

    cout << answer << '\n';
    return 0;
}
